product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx helps enterprise HR teams and business leaders collect and analyze employee feedback, activate improvements, and develop their people through an AI-powered employee experience platform.

pricing_page.notes: The public site offers demo/contact paths rather than a public pricing or plans page.

last_funding.notes: Latest located financing announcement: MUFG announced a five-year senior secured credit facility on July 30, 2024 to refinance debt and support growth.
